verdict.rationale: Superpowers is a library of markdown skills and plugins installed into coding-agent harnesses. It has no hosted service, API or account system of its own, so issuing scoped API credentials is outside its product category. Nothing in the evidence shows it ships any credential-issuance capability that would make this axis apply.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can issue scoped/least-privilege API credentials for an agent
